frames.narration: A new document starts with the Draft state object as its current state.
The user presses publish. The document does not check any status; it delegates to the current state.
Draft's rule for publish: move to Review. It swaps the document's state itself.
Same call now reaches a different object, so it does something different: Review approves it.
Review's rule: approved, move to Published.
Now the user tries to edit. The call is delegated to Published...
...and Published refuses. The rule 'no editing once published' lives in exactly one class.
